events.name: Terminal Velocity: Farewell Code-Off
events.description: Juniors challenge seniors in a thrilling competitive programming sprint. Dynamic problem sets spanning graphs, DP, and reverse engineering with live leaderboard projection.
rules: Individual participation or duo teams.
Allowed languages: C++, Python, Java, Go, Rust.
Live test-case evaluation on local platform.
Top 3 scorers receive bespoke trophy and cash awards.

events.name: Retro-Byte: CSE Nostalgia & Roast Stage
events.description: From surviving viva disasters to late night campus canteen sessions, share heartfelt tributes, roast your favorite batchmates, and celebrate our journey.
rules: Open mic slots limited to 5 minutes per speaker.
Respectful college humor; no personal defamation.
Faculty dedications welcome.

events.name: LAN Apocalypse: Valorant & BGMI Cup
events.description: The annual seniors vs. juniors LAN clash. 5v5 custom lobbies with live shoutcasting on the big auditorium screen.
rules: Valorant: 5 Players + 1 Sub per squad.
BGMI: 4 Players squad in custom room.
Standard competitive tournament rulebook applies.

events.name: Synapse Beats: Cultural Band & Dance
events.description: Performances curated by CSE talent: rock acoustics, hip-hop crews, fusion dance, and solo vocals lighting up the evening.
rules: Group performances: max 8 participants.
Music tracks must be submitted 24h in advance.
Stage time: 6-10 minutes.

events.name: Hall of Fame: Senior Awards & Memento Gala
events.tagline: Honoring the 2021-2027 Graduating CSE Batch (6-Year Integrated)
events.description: Prestigious memento distribution for all graduating seniors (2021-2027 batch), celebrating their complete 6-year journey (2 years PUC + 4 years B.Tech), batch superlative announcements, and grand farewell photo sessions.
rules: Formal / Ethnic dress code recommended.
Entry strictly verified with Digital QR Entry Pass.
Every graduating 2021-2027 CSE senior receives a custom 6-year farewell souvenir.
events.eligibility: Compulsory for all 4th Year B.Tech CSE (2021-2027 Batch)

events.name: Cipher Hunt: The CSE Mystery Trail
events.tagline: Decode Ciphers, Follow Hashes, Unlock The Vault
events.description: A campus-wide tech treasure hunt. Clues hidden behind QR codes, steganography images, and terminal challenges across the engineering block.
rules: Teams of 2 to 3 students.
Smartphones with internet required.
First team to unlock the master key wins.

events.name: HHO FUN GAMES
rules: Individual participation
